variants.name: D · ACID VOICE

Make the wordmark visibly lowercase and readable. No metallic/chrome material. Art direction: radical contemporary underground music poster, high-contrast acid yellow #D6FF00 and near-black with one small electric-blue accent. A huge vibrating black-and-lime optical waveform / stretched halftone mouth-like oval fills the RIGHT two-thirds, visually suggesting voice without a literal microphone icon. Dense rhythmic forms, sharp edges, printed halftone grit, high fashion club-flyer energy. NO calm white SaaS layout, no rounded cards, no beige, no serif, no glass, no paragraph copy. Bold editorial composition with disciplined hierarchy and vivid acid color.
